segments.title: This octopus chased lasers like a CAT
segments.say: This octopus chased lasers like a cat, three hundred twenty-three meters down.

segments.title: A robot was filming
segments.say: An ocean exploration robot called Hercules was filming near Hawaii.

segments.title: Two green laser dots
segments.say: It shines two green scaling lasers. The octopus kept chasing them. Then it pounced.

segments.title: Twilight zone, near darkness
segments.say: This was in the twilight zone, where almost no sunlight reaches.

segments.title: Smart, curious octopus
segments.say: The crew said it shows how intelligent octopuses likely are.
Follow for Weird Animal number 22 tomorrow.
